tools.name: hugging-kreuzberg-extract_bytes
tools.description: Accepts base64-encoded file data, decodes to binary, and POSTs to Kreuzberg POST /extract as multipart form data. Returns extracted text, metadata, and tables.

tools.name: hugging-kreuzberg-extract_structured
tools.description: Receives base64 file data only. Schema and model are configured server-side via environment variables. POSTs to Kreuzberg POST /extract-structured as multipart form data.
